description: This file defines data models, interfaces, enums, and utility functions related to import and export operations, including CSV to JSON conversion, for the Thingsboard project.

methods.name: convertCSVToJson
methods.description: Converts CSV string data to JSON format based on provided configuration, with error handling via callback.

methods.name: splitCSV
methods.description: Splits a CSV string into an array of fields, handling quoted fields and delimiters.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string represents a numeric value, considering comma as decimal separator.

methods.name: convertStringToJSType
methods.description: Converts a string to its appropriate JavaScript type (number, boolean, null, or string).
